question: Which of the following philosopher was born in Tamil Nadu in the eleventh century?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ramanuja**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ramanuja** was a famous Indian philosopher and theologian who was born in **Sriperumbudur**, **Tamil Nadu**, in the **eleventh century** (specifically around **1017 CE**).
 
• He was a major proponent of the **Sri Vaishnavism** tradition and is best known for propounding the philosophical doctrine of **Vishishtadvaita** (Qualified Non-dualism).
 
• His teachings were deeply influenced by the **Alvars**, who were Tamil saint-poets devoted to **Lord Vishnu**.
 
• **Ramanuja** argued that the soul (Atman) remains distinct even after merging with the Supreme God (Brahman), and he emphasized that **Bhakti** (intense devotion) was the path to salvation.
 
• He made the Vedic teachings accessible to the common people and worked towards social equality by allowing people from different backgrounds to enter the fold of **Vaishnavism**.
